children: , a cybersecurity company whose platform protects endpoints, identity, cloud and AI systems, said it will add Anthropic's Claude Mythos 5.1 to its Wayfinder Frontier AI Services offering. SentinelOne shares rose 1.25% as of 10:15 a.m. ET.

Wayfinder pairs frontier models from Anthropic, OpenAI and other labs with SentinelOne's offensive and defensive security experts, who find vulnerabilities in customer code and environments, confirm which can be exploited and set the order for fixes. SentinelOne didn't say when Mythos 5.1 will be added.

The company tied the move to a wave of AI-driven vulnerabilities and attacks this month that it said many have dubbed Black October. Chief Customer Officer Steve Stone pointed to a sharp increase in the volume and severity of vulnerability disclosures, including PHP2SHELL and LiteLLM. Separately, SentinelOne said it was named Pax8's most valuable vendor in EMEA.

title: SentinelOne Taps Anthropic's Mythos 5.1 After Black October Attacks
